lines.en: label thirdreset3:
scene picnicinspace1
I find Maya leaned up against a flowerbed, clasping a canned beverage and staring off at the sky- likely wondering when I’m going to get here.
lines.zh: 我发现 Maya 靠着花坛，攥着一罐饮料，凝视着天空——大概在想我什么时候才到。

lines.en: Little does she know, I’m right beside her.
lines.zh: 她不知道的是，我就在她旁边。

lines.en: : Quicker than usual this time.
lines.zh: : 这次比平时快。

lines.en: Or she already knows and was just trying to look cool.
lines.zh: 或者她早就知道了，只是想装酷。

lines.en: : Was I?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : I don’t even really remember the trip here, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我甚至不太记得来这儿的路了。

lines.en: scene picnicinspace2
: That’s to be expected.
lines.zh: : 这是意料之中的。

lines.en: : I was the same way the first...however many times it took for me to become comfortable with it.
lines.zh: : 最初……不管用了多少次才让我习惯，我也是这样的。

lines.en: : It’s not really possible to give you an exact number on account of me...not remembering those times.
lines.zh: : 我没法给你一个确切的数字，因为我……也不记得那些次了。

lines.en: : And the picnic?
lines.zh: : 那野餐呢？

lines.en: scene picnicinspace3
: A little present, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 算是一点小礼物吧。

lines.en: : To congratulate you on making it where no other Sensei has ever made it before.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你走到了从来没有别的 Sensei 走到过的地方。

lines.en: : It’s quite cold up here in the winter, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 冬天这上面挺冷的，不是吗？

lines.en: : Why prepare a picnic if you didn’t know how long I was going to be, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，如果你不知道我要花多久，为什么还要准备野餐呢？

lines.en: : I figured I could just eat everything myself if you didn’t show up within a reasonable amount of time.
lines.zh: : 我本来想着，要是你没在合理的时间内出现，我就自己把东西全吃了。

lines.en: : I’m slightly disappointed that you did, now that I’m actually thinking about it.
lines.zh: : 现在仔细想想，你真的来了，我反倒有点失望。

lines.en: : But, on the bright side, we can get food wherever we want on account of everyone else being gone.
lines.zh: : 不过往好处想，因为其他所有人都不在了，我们想吃什么就能去拿什么。

lines.en: : I’d suggest taking a trip to the maid cafe before things start to go down, but I just don’t think it would be the same without the flavor beam.
lines.zh: : 我本来想建议在一切崩塌之前去一趟女仆咖啡厅的，但我觉得没有味道光束就完全不一样了。

lines.en: scene picnicinspace4
: I can guarantee you that the flavor beam does not make even a tenth of the impact you think it does.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，味道光束产生的影响连你以为的十分之一都不到。

lines.en: : But that implies it does make {i}some{/i} difference.
lines.zh: : 但那也说明它确实{i}有点{/i}作用。

lines.en: : It’s a beam of flavor. Of course there will be some difference.
lines.zh: : 那可是味道的光束啊。当然会有些不同。

lines.en: : Do you want me to try beaming the food?
lines.zh: : 你想让我对着食物射一道试试？

lines.en: : Is this how things are going to be tonight? Because if it’s just going to be a party, we might as well get the reset out of the way now.
lines.zh: : 今晚就要这么过吗？如果只是开派对的话，我们还不如现在就把重置给办了。

lines.en: : Hey, you’re the one who laid out food and made it a special occasion. I’m just trying to have a good time.
lines.zh: : 嘿，是你把食物摆出来、把今晚搞得这么隆重的。我只是想好好玩玩。

lines.en: : Well then at least sit down. There’s more than enough room on the blanket for the two of us.
lines.zh: : 那至少坐下吧。毯子上够我们两个人坐的。

lines.en: : I think I’d prefer being {i}under{/i} the blanket with-
lines.zh: : 我觉得我更愿意在毯子{i}底下{/i}和——

lines.en: : Five more seconds and I’m eating everything myself.
lines.zh: : 再给你五秒钟，我就自己把东西全吃了。

lines.en: : Fine, fine. I get it.
lines.zh: : 好好好。我懂了。

lines.en: scene black
I walk past Maya, avoiding a trash can and bringing myself closer to the ground to take a spot on the blanket.
lines.zh: 我从 Maya 身边走过，避开一个垃圾桶，把身体放低，在毯子上占了个位置。

lines.en: It’s-
lines.zh: 那是——

lines.en: scene picnicinspace5
: Wait, did you get this blanket from my house?
lines.zh: : 等等，这条毯子是从我家拿的？

lines.en: : Possibly.
lines.zh: : 有可能。

lines.en: : Are we going to get it back? I think Ami really likes this blanket.
lines.zh: : 我们还能拿回去吗？我觉得 Ami 很喜欢这条毯子。

lines.en: : Possibly.
lines.zh: : 有可能。

lines.en: : I’ve never brought a blanket to the apocalypse before.
lines.zh: : 我以前从没带过毯子来末日。

lines.en: : I suppose we’ll just have to see how things pan out.
lines.zh: : 我想，我们只能看事情怎么发展了。

lines.en: : You could have just brought your own blanket.
lines.zh: : 你本来可以自己带条毯子的。

lines.en: : Why would I do that if there was a chance I wouldn’t get it back?
lines.zh: : 既然有拿不回来的风险，我为什么要那么做？

lines.en: : Maya...are you actually a bad person?
lines.zh: : Maya……你其实是个坏人吧？

lines.en: : Please. You are the last person I want to hear something like that from.
lines.zh: : 得了吧。我最不想听这种话的人就是你。

lines.en: : Now, are you going to eat? Or are you just going to sit here and ask me questions about blankets for the next several hours?
lines.zh: : 说吧，你到底吃不吃？还是打算就这么坐着，接下来几个小时一直问我关于毯子的问题？

lines.en: : I’m not really hungry.
lines.zh: : 我不太饿。

lines.en: : Also, why are you hugging a watermelon?
lines.zh: : 还有，你为什么抱着一个西瓜？

lines.en: : It’s a good melon.
lines.zh: : 这是个好瓜。

lines.en: : Can we talk about the world now?
lines.zh: : 我们现在能聊聊世界了吗？

lines.en: : That’s such a Maya thing to say.
lines.zh: : 这话说得真像 Maya。

lines.en: scene picnicinspace6
: I’m glad that you’re still here, but I have to say that I really wouldn’t mind if you’d lose the snarky pokes at how predictable I am under certain pretenses.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你还在这里，但我得说，如果你能少在那儿刻薄地戳穿我在某些情况下有多好预测，我真的会很高兴。

lines.en: : That’s the closest you’ve ever come to saying you love me.
lines.zh: : 这是你有史以来最接近说爱我的一次。

lines.en: : I’m trying to be serious here.
lines.zh: : 我是在认真说话。

lines.en: scene picnicinspace7
: I have absolutely no idea what’s going to happen after tonight.
lines.zh: : 今晚之后会发生什么，我完全没有头绪。

lines.en: : Maybe we’ll get ten more students. Maybe {i}our{/i}[school] will fall into an inexplicable sinkhole.
lines.zh: : 也许我们会多出十名学生。也许{i}我们的{/i}[school]会陷入一个无法解释的塌陷坑。

lines.en: : There’s no way of knowing.
lines.zh: : 无从得知。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t mind ten more students, but I highly doubt we’d be able to fit them into the classroom.
lines.zh: : 多十名学生我倒是不介意，但我很怀疑教室能不能塞得下。

lines.en: : I’d like to formally urge you to {i}not{/i} think about things like that for now and, instead, think about what you’re going to do if something goes wrong with someone you already know.
lines.zh: : 我正式建议你暂时{i}别{/i}想那些，转而想想：如果你已经认识的某个人出了事，你打算怎么办。

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你是什么意思？

lines.en: Maya stops talking for a moment and takes a bite out of a slice of pre-cut watermelon.
lines.zh: Maya 停顿了片刻，咬了一口事先切好的西瓜。

lines.en: She washes it down with a quarter-bottle of green tea before finally speaking again.
lines.zh: 她用四分之一瓶绿茶把它送下去，然后才再次开口。

lines.en: : We’ve talked before about what you’d do if {i}I{/i} were to suddenly undergo a dramatic change, correct?
lines.zh: : 我们以前聊过，如果{i}我{/i}突然发生了剧烈的变化，你会怎么做，对吧？

lines.en: : I think so. About whether or not you’d still be the same person afterward and all of that.
lines.zh: : 好像聊过。聊的是事后的你是不是还是同一个人之类的。

lines.en: : Right.
: Do you think that’s going to happen?
lines.zh: : 你觉得那会发生吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know what’s going to happen. I already told you that.
lines.zh: : 我不知道会发生什么。我已经告诉过你了。

lines.en: : But I do know that there have been several times as of late where I’ve been forced to recall certain things that I’d much prefer to stay buried.
lines.zh: : 但我确实知道，最近有几次我被迫回忆起了一些我宁愿它们永远深埋的事。

lines.en: : Like what?
lines.zh: : 比如什么？

lines.en: : Well, Noriko’s presence drudges up a number of bad memories, as I’m sure you've ascertained.
lines.zh: : 嗯，Noriko 的存在勾起了不少糟糕的回忆，这点我想你也看出来了。

lines.en: : But there was another occurrence recently, during the test of courage to be specific, that made me come to terms with my existence not being as permanent as it may have seemed.
lines.zh: : 不过最近还有另一件事——具体说就是试胆大会那次——让我不得不接受，我的存在并不像看上去那么恒久。

lines.en: : During the dorm war?
lines.zh: : 宿舍大战那次？

lines.en: : I wasn’t around for your contest, so I don’t really know how it went.
lines.zh: : 你们的比试我不在场，所以不太清楚情况如何。

lines.en: : And I’m not going to {i}tell{/i} you how it went as it would only further complicate things.
lines.zh: : 而且我也不打算{i}告诉{/i}你过程，因为那只会让事情更复杂。

lines.en: : That sounds rough considering how complicated things already are.
lines.zh: : 考虑到事情本来就够复杂了，听上去还挺糟的。

lines.en: scene picnicinspace8
: It does, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是啊，不是吗？

lines.en: : Don’t get me wrong, I’d much prefer to remain exactly where I am.
lines.zh: : 别误会，我当然更愿意就待在现在这个位置。

lines.en: : I’m not very fond of the concept of just...not existing.
lines.zh: : 我不太喜欢就这么……不再存在这个念头。

lines.en: : So, when we do this tonight, I’m going back to the original method of hugging you and not attempting something childish like holding your hands instead.
lines.zh: : 所以今晚我们做这件事的时候，我会回到最初的方法——抱住你，而不是去做什么幼稚的事，比如改成牵你的手。

lines.en: : Bring it on.
lines.zh: : 来吧。

lines.en: scene picnicinspace5
: Please don’t sound that excited or it’s going to be extremely weird for me.
lines.zh: : 拜托别这么兴奋，不然我会觉得非常怪。

lines.en: : It’s already extremely weird given our relationship.
lines.zh: : 鉴于我们的关系，这本来就够怪的了。

lines.en: : Yes, yes. We dislike each other immensely.
lines.zh: : 对对对。我们特别讨厌彼此。

lines.en: scene black
We spend the next hour or so watching stars pass overhead.
lines.zh: 接下来的一个小时左右，我们就看着星星从头顶掠过。

lines.en: It could have been more than an hour, though.
lines.zh: 不过也可能不止一个小时。

lines.en: There’s really no good way of telling considering all of the clocks have stopped and our phones don’t have service.
lines.zh: 考虑到所有的钟都停了、手机也没有信号，真的没法判断。

lines.en: I wonder if the sun would come out if we waited long enough?
lines.zh: 我在想，如果我们等得够久，太阳会不会出来？

lines.en: Probably not.
lines.zh: 大概不会。

lines.en: If time isn’t moving, I highly doubt the sun is.
lines.zh: 如果时间没有流动，我很怀疑太阳会流动。

lines.en: I wouldn’t mind things getting a little warmer for a bit, though.
lines.zh: 不过我倒不介意暖和一会儿。

lines.en: scene picnicinspace9
: So, now that this has become somewhat of another tradition for us, albeit one that has only made it to the highly unimpressive total of three-
lines.zh: : 那么，既然这对我们来说已经算是又一个传统了——尽管它只走到了三个这样毫不惊人的总数——

lines.en: : Is there anything else you’d like to ask me?
lines.zh: : 你还有什么想问我的吗？

lines.en: : I’m surprised you’re still giving me the opportunity after revealing that you can’t really...reveal too much without breaking me.
lines.zh: : 我很意外，在你说过不能……透露太多、否则会把我弄坏之后，你还愿意给我这个机会。

lines.en: : Just giving you the opportunity to ask certain things doesn’t mean I have to answer them truthfully, if even at all.
lines.zh: : 给你机会问某些问题，不代表我就得如实回答，甚至不代表我非答不可。

lines.en: : That doesn’t really convince me that I want to ask you anything.
lines.zh: : 这可没能让我更想问你什么。

lines.en: scene picnicinspace10
: Then I suppose you should close your eyes and-
lines.zh: : 那我想你该闭上眼睛，然后——

lines.en: : Wait, wait, wait. Hold on.
lines.zh: : 等等等等等等。等等。

lines.en: : I’m sure I can think of something.
lines.zh: : 我肯定能想到点什么。

lines.en: : Uhh...
menu thirdresetroof:
What happened with you and Noriko?
lines.zh: 你和 Noriko 之间发生了什么？

lines.en: : Can you tell me more about what led to you hating Noriko as much as you do?
lines.zh: : 你能多说一点吗，是什么让你这么恨 Noriko？

lines.en: scene picnicinspace11
: Really? {i}That{/i} is what you’re going to ask me about?
lines.zh: : 真的假的？你就要问{i}这个{/i}？

lines.en: : I think it’s a pretty good question.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这是个挺好的问题。

lines.en: : It’s a fine question I guess, but it’s not something I particularly enjoy talking about.
lines.zh: : 算是个不错的问题吧，但这不是我特别喜欢聊的事。

lines.en: : She’s just an overall bad person.
lines.zh: : 她就是个彻头彻尾的坏人。

lines.en: : Why, though?
lines.zh: : 可是为什么呢？

lines.en: : She’s been nothing but nice to me and everyone else since she got here.
lines.zh: : 她来了以后，对我和其他所有人都一直很好。

lines.en: : Sure, she did say one questionable thing about {i}you{/i}...but it’s not like you haven’t done the same on...even more occasions.
lines.zh: : 当然，她确实说过一句关于你不妥的话……可{i}你{/i}也不是没做过同样的事，而且……次数还更多。

lines.en: scene picnicinspace12
: Hah...
: You wouldn’t understand if I explained it to you.
lines.zh: : 就算我解释给你听，你也不会懂。

lines.en: : You have literally explained resetting time to me and that seemed to turn out okay.
lines.zh: : 你可是真的跟我解释过重置时间的事，那看起来结果还不错啊。

lines.en: : I can assure you that my distaste for that girl is even harder to explain.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，我对那个女孩的反感更难解释。

lines.en: : Just ask me about something else.
lines.zh: : 换个别的问吧。

lines.en: $ reset3q1 = True
jump thirdresetroof
How do you feel about birds?
lines.zh: 你对鸟有什么感觉？

lines.en: : How do you feel about birds?
lines.zh: : 你对鸟有什么感觉？

lines.en: scene picnicinspace11
: Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Just...birds in general.
lines.zh: : 就是……鸟，泛指的鸟。

lines.en: : Is this like, some sort of compatibility test or something?
lines.zh: : 这是某种配对测试之类的吗？

lines.en: : You don’t think this is a date, do you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会以为这是在约会吧？

lines.en: : I’m just curious.
lines.zh: : 我只是好奇。

lines.en: : They’re...fine?
lines.zh: : 它们……还行吧？

lines.en: : I don’t know what you want me to say here.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你想让我说什么。

lines.en: $ reset3q2 = True
jump thirdresetroof
When can I try to do this?
lines.zh: 我什么时候能试着做这个？

lines.en: : When can I try to do this?
lines.zh: : 我什么时候能试着做这个？

lines.en: scene picnicinspace13
: Try what?
lines.zh: : 试着做什么？

lines.en: : Resetting?
lines.zh: : 重置？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: You’ve said that anyone can do it before.
lines.zh: : 你以前说过任何人都能做到。

lines.en: : When do I get to take a stab at it?
lines.zh: : 我什么时候能试一把？

lines.en: scene picnicinspace11
: It’s something that needs to be approached with a little more seriousness than just “taking a stab at it.”
lines.zh: : 这件事需要更严肃地对待，不能只是「试一把」。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll have your chance whenever I’ve overstayed my welcome and you’re forced to wait for somebody else on the rooftop.
lines.zh: : 我相信你会等到机会的——等我赖在这里太久了，你就不得不在屋顶上等别的什么人。

lines.en: : That...actually sounds really lonely.
lines.zh: : 那……听起来其实挺孤独的。

lines.en: : Yes. It sucks and I wouldn’t wish it upon anyone.
lines.zh: : 是啊。糟透了，我不会希望任何人经历这种事。

lines.en: : Good luck.
lines.zh: : 祝你好运。

lines.en: : Well thank you very much for all of the encouragement.
lines.zh: : 呵，非常感谢你这些鼓励。

lines.en: : I’m proud of you, Maya.
lines.zh: : 我为你骄傲，Maya。

lines.en: : Good job hanging in there.
lines.zh: : 撑到现在，干得好。

lines.en: scene picnicinspace12
: Please don’t act like some sort of guardian. It’s actually rather disgusting.
lines.zh: : 拜托别摆出一副监护人的样子。那其实挺恶心的。

lines.en: : Just continue to do as I tell you until one of us ceases to exist.
lines.zh: : 你只要继续照我说的做，直到我们中有一个不复存在为止。

lines.en: $ reset3q3 = True
jump thirdresetroof
Have you ever watched someone disappear?
lines.zh: 你曾见过某个人消失吗？

lines.en: : I’ve been wondering, but....
lines.zh: : 我一直很好奇，不过……

lines.en: : Have you ever actually witnessed someone disappearing?
lines.zh: : 你真的亲眼见过有人消失吗？

lines.en: scene picnicinspace10
: Unfortunately, I have.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾，我见过。

lines.en: : Though, it’s been quite some time since it last happened.
lines.zh: : 不过上一次发生已经是很久以前的事了。

lines.en: : Do you mind if I ask who it was?
lines.zh: : 介意我问是谁吗？

lines.en: scene picnicinspace14
: It’s happened with multiple people...but the most notable example was probably with Ami.
lines.zh: : 发生在好几个人身上过……但最值得一提的例子大概是 Ami。

lines.en: : Since the two of us are roommates, I’ve seen it through mere happenstance on a number of occasions.
lines.zh: : 因为我们俩是室友，我碰巧撞见过好几次。

lines.en: : Each and every one of them has been horrifying and unforgettable.
lines.zh: : 每一次都恐怖得令人难以忘怀。

lines.en: : I hope you never have to see anything like it.
lines.zh: : 我希望你永远都不用看到那种场面。

lines.en: : Especially with someone you care about.
lines.zh: : 尤其是对你在乎的人。

lines.en: : You really love Ami, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你真的很爱 Ami，对吧？

lines.en: scene picnicinspace15
: I really do.
lines.zh: : 我真的爱她。

lines.en: : Though, it’s hard to explain exactly why.
lines.zh: : 不过，具体为什么很难解释。

lines.en: : I’m sure it’s the same for you.
lines.zh: : 我想你也是一样的。

lines.en: : It’s probably a lot easier for me to love her since she cooks and cleans for me every day.
lines.zh: : 我大概更容易爱她，因为她每天都给我做饭、打扫。

lines.en: scene picnicinspace16
: Oh, okay. I guess we’re done actually opening up about our mutual feelings for a girl who would likely die for both of us and are just going to make jokes about it.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。看来我们已经不愿意再认真袒露对一个愿意为我们俩去死的女孩的共同感情了，干脆拿来开玩笑算了。

lines.en: : Of course I {i}actually{/i} love her. There’s just a {i}reason{/i} for me to love her.
lines.zh: : 我当然是{i}真的{/i}爱她。只是我有个爱她的{i}理由{/i}。

lines.en: : For you, it’s just-
lines.zh: : 对你来说，那只是——

lines.en: scene picnicinspace10
: Since when does anyone need a reason to love anyone?
lines.zh: : 从什么时候开始，爱一个人需要理由了？

lines.en: : Love simply {i}is{/i}.
lines.zh: : 爱{i}就是{/i}爱。

lines.en: : But I’m afraid that topic is far too sappy and devoid of logic for me to go into detail about it.
lines.zh: : 不过我担心这个话题太肉麻、太缺乏逻辑，我没法细说。

lines.en: : Ask me something else now.
lines.zh: : 现在问点别的吧。

lines.en: $ reset3q4 = True
jump thirdresetroof
I don’t have any more questions
lines.zh: 我没有更多问题了

lines.en: : I think that’s it for tonight.
lines.zh: : 我想今晚就到这儿吧。

lines.en: : Let’s get this show on the road.
lines.zh: : 让我们开始吧。

lines.en: scene picnicinspace17
: Someone has gotten awfully comfortable with the end of the world.
lines.zh: : 有人已经对世界末日习惯得可怕了。

lines.en: : Nah. I’m just really looking forward to the hug I’m about to get.
lines.zh: : 没有。我只是很期待马上要得到的那个拥抱。

lines.en: : The hug that you’re only going to get out of absolute necessity.
lines.zh: : 那个你只是出于绝对必要才会得到的拥抱。

lines.en: : Is it really a necessity if you’re choosing to do it?
lines.zh: : 如果是你自己选择要做的，那还能叫必要吗？

lines.en: : Yes. Because it will also provide me the peace of mind in knowing that another[school] will likely {i}not{/i} wind up in the ground and-
lines.zh: : 是。因为它还能让我安心：知道又一所[school]大概{i}不会{/i}陷进地里，而且——

lines.en: scene picnicinspace18
: What...is this?...
lines.zh: : 这……是什么？……

lines.en: scene picnicinspace19
: ...what?
scene picnicinspace20
: What’s...going on?
lines.zh: : 发生……什么事了？

lines.en: : I thought it was weird that no one was at the dorm when I got back, but...
lines.zh: : 我回去的时候宿舍一个人都没有，我就觉得奇怪，可是……

lines.en: : I...I just assumed they were either all at Sensei’s house or...just...I...
lines.zh: : 我……我只是以为她们要么都在 Sensei 家，要么就……只是……我……

lines.en: : And...and then my phone wasn’t working, so I just went to sleep and...
lines.zh: : 而且……而且后来我手机也没信号了，所以我就去睡了，然后……

lines.en: : This...
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: Ayane somehow manages to find her way onto the roof during the one time I’d never expect her to be here.
lines.zh: Ayane 不知怎的找到了上屋顶的路，偏偏是在我最想不到她会出现的一次。

lines.en: And, judging by Maya’s reaction, I think it’s safe to say she didn’t expect her here either.
lines.zh: 而从 Maya 的反应来看，我敢说她也没想到 Ayane 会在这儿。

lines.en: : Is...something happening?
lines.zh: : 是不是……发生了什么？

lines.en: scene black
Maya quickly straightens herself out and slaps her cheeks before making her way over to Ayane to...
lines.zh: Maya 迅速整理好自己，拍了拍脸颊，然后走向 Ayane，打算……

lines.en: Actually, I have no idea how she’s going to explain this.
lines.zh: 其实，我完全不知道她要怎么解释这件事。

lines.en: scene picnicinspace21
: You...
: How did you get here?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么到这儿来的？

lines.en: : What do you mean?...I just...walked...
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？……我就是……走过来的……

lines.en: : I was here earlier with Sensei and...
lines.zh: : 我刚才和 Sensei 在这儿，然后……

lines.en: : Maya...what’s going on right now?
lines.zh: : Maya……现在到底怎么回事？

lines.en: : This...
: It’s the end of the world.
lines.zh: : 是世界末日。

lines.en: scene picnicinspace22
: Sensei...I know we were making that joke earlier, but...I’m really scared right now and this isn’t the time for-
lines.zh: : Sensei……我知道我们刚才在拿这个开玩笑，可是……我现在真的很害怕，现在不是时候——

lines.en: : It’s not a joke.
lines.zh: : 那不是玩笑。

lines.en: : It really is the end of the world.
lines.zh: : 真的是世界末日。

lines.en: : But the world is going to start over.
lines.zh: : 但世界会重新开始。

lines.en: : Hopefully.
lines.zh: : 希望如此。

lines.en: scene picnicinspace23
: What do you mean hopefully?! Where did everyone go?!
lines.zh: : 什么叫希望如此？！大家都去哪儿了？！

lines.en: : Ayane...everyone is gone. But they’ll be coming back any minute now.
lines.zh: : Ayane……大家都不在了。但他们随时都会回来。

lines.en: : What I’m more concerned about is how you managed to make it here.
lines.zh: : 我更在意的是，你是怎么到这儿来的。

lines.en: scene picnicinspace24
: I told you! All I did was walk...
lines.zh: : 我说了啊！我就是走过来的……

lines.en: : But why {i}here{/i}?
lines.zh: : 可为什么是{i}这里{/i}？

lines.en: : What led you to the roof of the[school] specifically?
lines.zh: : 是什么把你引到了[school]的屋顶上？

lines.en: scene picnicinspace25
: What...
lines.zh: : 什么……

lines.en: : What was it again?
lines.zh: : 是什么来着？

lines.en: : Maya, do you have any idea-
lines.zh: : Maya，你知道吗——

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 知道。

lines.en: : But we don’t have the time to talk about it now.
lines.zh: : 但我们现在没时间谈这个。

lines.en: scene picnicinspace26
: I’m so...confused...
lines.zh: : 我好……混乱……

lines.en: : Why did I come here and...
lines.zh: : 我为什么会来这里，还有……

lines.en: : And where is everyone else?
lines.zh: : 还有其他人都在哪儿？

lines.en: : You’ll see them again in no time at all.
lines.zh: : 你很快就会再见到他们的。

lines.en: : Just think of this all as one elaborate dream.
lines.zh: : 就把这一切当成一场精心编排的梦吧。

lines.en: : And, if it ever happens again, we can talk about it a little more.
lines.zh: : 如果以后再发生，我们可以再多聊一点。

lines.en: : A...dream?...
: Just do what Maya says and everything should turn out fine.
lines.zh: : 照 Maya 说的做，一切都会没事的。

lines.en: : Hopefully.
lines.zh: : 希望如此。

lines.en: : Hopefully.
lines.zh: : 希望如此。

lines.en: scene picnicinspace27
: I’m really scared, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我好害怕，Sensei……

lines.en: : Would coming a little closer help you feel better?
lines.zh: : 再靠近一点会让你好受些吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but...what about Maya?...
lines.zh: : 嗯，可是……那 Maya 怎么办？……

lines.en: : It’s extremely out of character for me to suggest something like this, but I think a group hug is in order.
lines.zh: : 提出这种建议实在不像我会做的事，但我觉得我们该来个集体拥抱。

lines.en: : We’ll take a moment to catch our breath and then figure out how we’re going to handle this together...
lines.zh: : 我们先缓一口气，然后再一起想想该怎么应对……

lines.en: scene black
So that’s what the gameplan is.
lines.zh: 计划就是这样。

lines.en: I can already tell that Maya is just going to go through with the reset once the three of us are in physical contact with one another.
lines.zh: 我已经看得出来，等我们三个有了肢体接触，Maya 就会直接把重置进行下去。

lines.en: I still don’t fully understand how this process works but, if the “proper method” includes a simple embrace, adding one more person to the mix wouldn’t do anything bad, would it?
lines.zh: 我还是没完全搞懂这个过程是怎么回事，但如果「正确的方法」只是一个简单的拥抱，那多加一个人进来也不会有什么坏处吧？

lines.en: And...even if it does, there’s always the chance that none of us will ever find out about it.
lines.zh: 而且……就算有，也很有可能我们谁都不会知道。

lines.en: Everything is going to be okay.
lines.zh: 一切都会好起来的。

lines.en: scene picnicinspace28
: Keep your eyes closed, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 闭上眼睛，Ayane。

lines.en: : Okay...
: I’m using Sensei’s shirt to dry my face, so I wouldn’t really be able to see anything anyway.
lines.zh: : 我在用 Sensei 的衬衫擦脸，所以本来也看不到什么。

lines.en: Ayane claws at my shirt and clips some of my skin in the process.
lines.zh: Ayane 抓住我的衬衫，顺带还掐到了我一点皮肉。

lines.en: She’s trembling as if she were a dying animal on the side of the road, soaking wet after smacking off the windshield of a car and being tossed into a nearby rain-filled pothole.
lines.zh: 她颤抖着，像一只被车撞飞、又被抛进旁边积满雨水的坑里、浑身湿透、躺在路边奄奄一息的动物。

lines.en: And I’d like to say that Maya is the complete opposite-
lines.zh: 我本想说 Maya 完全是相反的样子——

lines.en: But the truth is that she’s trembling as well.
lines.zh: 但事实是，她也在颤抖。

lines.en: Less like roadkill and more like a very subtle earthquake, though.
lines.zh: 只不过不像路边的死动物，更像一场非常轻微的地震。

lines.en: Like there’s something happening beneath her that’s-
lines.zh: 像是有什么东西在她身体深处发生——
: 是不是……

lines.en: : Is the ground...shaking right now?
lines.zh: : 地面……现在在晃吗？

lines.en: : It’s all in your head.
lines.zh: : 都是你的错觉。

lines.en: : Sensei, are your eyes closed as well?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你也闭上眼睛了吗？

lines.en: scene picnicinspace29
: Yeah.
